verdict.line: You lose if you fight into a full Devour stack or shove into his E sustain; you win if you snowball a kill before level 6 Abyssal Dive.

brief.thesis: This is an even lane on paper (49.4% over 87 games) but the power distribution is lopsided: Tahm Kench is nearly unkillable once his passive stacks and E shield are up, so Riven's entire plan is to burst him down with cooldowns stacked before he can reactively shield, not to out-sustain him.

tell.watch: Tahm Kench's An Acquired Taste stacks

theirWindow.when: he has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste
theirWindow.what: His next Q (Tongue Lash) stuns you on hit and consumes the stacks, and at 6 he can follow a stun with Devour for a near-unanswerable burst. Do not let him land three free pokes on you.

yourWindow.when: his E (Thick Skin) is on cooldown and stored damage is low
yourWindow.what: Thick Skin has only a 3s cooldown but its shield value depends on stored damage from being out of combat — if you've been trading constantly he has nothing banked to convert. Dive with Q (Broken Wings) into W (Ki Burst) right after he's taken poke damage and hasn't had a window to passively store it.

boots.why: 57.7% pick rate and the higher winrate option (45.3%) — the cooldown reduction tightens your Q/W/E loop so you can chain abilities before his Thick Skin shield comes back up.

core.why: Most common first core item; the shield-on-hit procs reward the burst-then-disengage pattern you need against his E sustain.

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacking adaptive force and healing on extended trades matches how this lane is actually won — repeated short trades, not one clean burst, since his E negates burst damage if mistimed.

summoners.why: Run at 98.4% pick rate and the only summoner set with a positive sample (54.8% winrate) — Ignite denies his Thick Skin passive healing and punishes his low early kill pressure.

playing.title: Don't engage before level 3
playing.detail: OP.GG's own data confirms it: avoid trading until you have Q, W, and E online, since a 1-2 ability trade loses to his Tongue Lash poke and E block value.

playing.title: Learn E first, not Q
playing.detail: The 55.6% skill order opens Q but puts E second — take Valor by level 2 so you can block the Tongue Lash damage that builds his stacks and heals him.

playing.title: Burst before he banks E charge
playing.detail: Thick Skin's 3s cooldown means he can shield constantly, but the shield size depends on stored damage — open fights immediately after he's already taken poke damage, not after a quiet period.

playing.title: Track stacks, dodge the stun
playing.detail: At 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste his next Tongue Lash stuns and resets the counter — back off or interrupt with your own trade before he reaches 3.

playing.title: Use R timing around his dive
playing.detail: Blade of the Exile's Wind Slash threat should come right as or just after his Abyssal Dive lands, since the knockup leaves him stationary and unable to immediately re-shield.

playing.title: Respect level 6 Devour all-in
playing.detail: Once he hits 6, a landed stun into Devour can delete you in one rotation — only commit to extended trades near his tower range if you have Flash up.

playing.title: Shove waves, don't dive
playing.detail: His kit rewards you walking into range; punish with ranged poke from Tongue Lash's threat zone avoidance and force him to initiate instead.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates are pulled directly from measured Riven vs Tahm Kench games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own analysis layered on top of that data.
